reviews.title: I Mean, It's OLED
reviews.comment:
It's OLED, it's amazing. Basically, it's worth it, but ofc try to get deals or get it while it's on sale or something. If you do decide to buy it, PLEASE FOR THE LOVE OF GOD, clean the screen very, very carefully, you can APPARENTLY mess up the coating otherwise. Thankfully mine didn't get too messed up, but I'm a perfectionist and it kills me sometimes; in fact, that's the whole reason I even came to bestbuy's site right now—to see if the warranty could potentially help me out here (it won't), but then I saw "Tell others what you think - and you could win a $400 gift card!". 
P.S. probably just gonna use warm water to clean the screen from now on (I sprayed 70% IPA on it before)
reviews.author: Magics4564

reviews.title: Great balance
reviews.comment: I bought this mostly for gaming but ended up enjoying it just as much for everyday use. The curve feels natural and not distracting, and the image quality is impressive right out of the box. Bright highlights, deep blacks, and smooth performance. It made my whole desk setup look and feel better. Definitely a good pick.
